In ''Star Wars'' CCG every game is a contest between two '''sides''' of the Force: one player plays a '''Light Side''' deck and the other a '''Dark Side''' deck.<ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref>

== Cards and decks ==
Light Side cards have the Rebel symbol on the back and Dark Side cards have the Imperial symbol. Each game deck has exactly 60 cards, all from one side of the Force.<ref name="rb20" />

Some unique (•) cards exist for both sides (for example •Ice Storm). Only one copy of such a card may be on table at a time, whichever side it belongs to.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref>

== Locations ==
Each location card has a Light Side half and a Dark Side half. The starting locations are placed so that the half with blue lightsaber Force icons faces the Light Side player and the half with red lightsaber icons faces the Dark Side player.<ref name="rb20" /> Many locations come in both a Light Side and a Dark Side version, with different game text and Force icons. A player may convert the opponent's version of a location by deploying their own version on top of it.<ref name="rb20" />

== In play ==
* The Dark Side player takes the first turn of the game; players then alternate turns.<ref name="rb20" />
* Each side activates Force from its own Force icons and Force drains the opponent's icons at locations it controls (see [[Phase]] and [[Force drain]]).<ref name="rb20" />
* Only the Dark Side may capture; both sides may steal (see [[Captive]]).<ref name="gl20" />
